## About
Amy and Jeff Duncan live in the North Fort Worth area and are active in their sons' high school activities and their community. Jeff grew up in North Fort Worth, graduated from Keller High School, and has been involved in construction all his life. Amy brings a background in finance.
We try to run this company by the Golden Rule. Amy came up with our slogan: "We strive to make every person feel special & important." That goes for our clients and for everyone we meet along the way.
We handle residential and commercial work, and our clients have included churches, schools, hotels and local businesses such as Glenview Baptist Church, Element Hotel and Dillard's.

## Services
- Roof replacement: Full roof replacements for homes, including after storm damage.
- Roof repair: Repairs for problems like missing shingles and other damage.
- Commercial roofing: New roofs for businesses and commercial buildings.

## FAQ
Q: Can you fix a few missing shingles while I plan a full replacement?
A: Yes. One reviewer said our team offered to repair her missing shingles while she got started on a roof replacement.

Q: Do you take on projects besides roofing?
A: Yes. One reviewer hired us for a roof replacement and later for a shower remodel and other repairs, including her fence.

Q: Where is your office?
A: We're at 4565 Keller Haslet Rd in Keller, Texas.
